summary: Browser redirector distributed via npm/jsDelivr; no installer-side harm
details: The package's main `px.js` is browser-only code that uses `document.write` / `document.createElement` to inject a full-viewport iframe pointing at `https://mfmz.gzhrfq.cn/H.html?c=0gjr`. The tarball also ships `update_px8my.sh`, which documents an automated pipeline to rewrite the redirect domain, bump the version, `npm publish`, and purge the jsDelivr cache — using npm as a mutable CDN backing for a rotating browser redirector (typical of gambling / illicit traffic monetization). There are no npm lifecycle scripts (no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare), no Node-reachable top-level side effects, no filesystem or credential access, and no network calls executed on the installer. `require()`ing this module in Node would throw because `document` is undefined. The harm surface is limited to end-users of third-party sites that load this file through jsDelivr, not developers or build systems that install the package from npm.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
